You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To use powdered peanut butter, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Locate the jar of powdered peanut butter in the pantry (30 seconds)
Step 2. Clean a small mixing bowl (2 minutes)
Step 3. Dispose of the safety seal (10 seconds)
Step 4. Decide on the desired consistency (1 minute)
Step 5. Taste the final mixture (5 seconds)
Step 6. Take the lid off the jar (5 seconds)
Step 7. Select a liquid for mixing, such as water or almond milk (30 seconds)
Step 8. Find a clean tablespoon for measuring (1 minute)
Step 9. Shake the jar to loosen the powder (10 seconds)
Step 10. Dry the mixing bowl thoroughly (1 minute)
Step 11. Wipe down the countertop (2 minutes)
Step 12. Measure the first tablespoon of powder (20 seconds)
Step 13. Measure the second tablespoon of powder (20 seconds)
Step 14. Place the bowl on a stable surface (10 seconds)
Step 15. Add a pinch of salt if desired (5 seconds)
Step 16. Inspect the spoon for debris (5 seconds)
Step 17. Read the serving size instructions on the label (1 minute)
Step 18. Set the spoon aside (5 seconds)
Step 19. Add a drop of honey for sweetness (10 seconds)
Step 20. Clear a workspace on the kitchen counter (3 minutes)
Step 21. Check the expiration date on the jar (10 seconds)
Step 22. Scoop the powder into the bowl (15 seconds)
Step 23. Tap the jar to settle the remaining contents (5 seconds)
Step 24. Calculate the powder-to-water ratio (30 seconds)
Step 25. Put on an apron (1 minute)
Step 26. Break the outer plastic seal of the jar (20 seconds)
Step 27. Research alternative recipes online (15 minutes)
Step 28. Retrieve the jar from the shelf (10 seconds)
Step 29. Note the protein content for your fitness tracker (1 minute)
Step 30. Get a small whisk from the drawer (45 seconds)

Step 32. Verify you have enough liquid (20 seconds)
Step 33. Adjust the ratio for a thicker spread (20 seconds)
Step 34. Pour the liquid into a measuring cup (30 seconds)
Step 35. Fetch the liquid from the refrigerator (45 seconds)
Step 36. Rinse the measuring cup (1 minute)
Step 37. Level off the powder in the tablespoon (10 seconds)
Step 38. Close the pantry door (5 seconds)
Step 39. Place the jar on the counter (5 seconds)
Step 40. Put the tablespoon in the dishwasher (10 seconds)
Step 41. Wipe the rim of the jar (15 seconds)
Step 42. Look for a stirring spatula (1 minute)
Step 43. Combine the powder and liquid in the bowl (10 seconds)
Step 44. Set the liquid container down (5 seconds)
Step 45. Wash your hands (40 seconds)
Step 46. Check the kitchen lighting (5 seconds)
Step 47. Retrieve a napkin (10 seconds)
Step 48. Consider if you want to add cocoa powder (30 seconds)
Step 49. Check the texture of the powder (5 seconds)
Step 50. Stir the mixture slowly to avoid dust (30 seconds)
Step 51. Prepare a slice of bread for the spread (45 seconds)
Step 52. Gather all necessary supplies (2 minutes)
Step 53. Smell the powder for freshness (5 seconds)
Step 54. Stir vigorously to remove lumps (1 minute)
Step 55. Double-check the measurements (30 seconds)
Step 56. Think about the snack pairing (1 minute)
Step 57. Pour a small amount of liquid into the powder (10 seconds)
Step 58. Reach for the jar (5 seconds)
Step 59. Scrape the sides of the bowl (20 seconds)
Step 60. Check the viscosity of the paste (10 seconds)
Step 61. Ensure the bowl is not chipped (10 seconds)
Step 62. Place the whisk into the bowl (5 seconds)
Step 63. Add an extra teaspoon of liquid (10 seconds)
Step 64. Identify the best stirring technique (15 seconds)
Step 65. Let the mixture sit for a moment to hydrate (2 minutes)
Step 66. Screw the lid back onto the jar (10 seconds)
Step 67. Prepare a serving plate (1 minute)
Step 68. Put the liquid back in the fridge (30 seconds)
Step 69. Whisk until the color is uniform (45 seconds)
Step 70. Final stir for a glossy finish (15 seconds)
Step 71. Spread the peanut butter onto your food (1 minute)
Step 72. Read the calorie count (30 seconds)
Step 73. Decide on the bowl size (20 seconds)
Step 74. Measure the liquid volume (20 seconds)
Step 75. Open the jar (10 seconds)
Step 76. Toast the bread (3 minutes)
Step 77. Clean the workspace (5 minutes)
Step 78. Ensure no dry powder remains at the bottom (20 seconds)
Step 79. Pour the powder into the mixing vessel (10 seconds)
Step 80. Scrape the remaining powder from the spoon (15 seconds)
Step 81. Check for a smooth consistency (10 seconds)
Step 82. Add a final splash of liquid if too thick (10 seconds)
Step 83. Organize the ingredients on the counter (2 minutes)
Step 84. Clean the knife used for spreading (1 minute)
Step 85. Measure out the base powder amount (30 seconds)
Step 86. Put the jar back in the pantry (30 seconds)
Step 87. Wipe away any spilled powder (30 seconds)
Step 88. Enjoy the smell of the peanut butter (10 seconds)
Step 89. Take a photo of the snack (2 minutes)
Step 90. Walk into the kitchen (10 seconds)
